mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, package_code, package_name, description, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time FROM ai_skill_package WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND package_code = #{code} AND del_flag = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ai_skill_package_version v JOIN ai_skill_package p ON p.id = v.package_id AND p.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.del_flag = 0
AND (p.package_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.package_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND v.status = #{status}
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC

SELECT FROM ai_skill_package_version v JOIN ai_skill_package p ON p.id = v.package_id AND p.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE v.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.package_id = #{packageId} AND v.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT id, tenant_id, version_id, file_path, content, content_hash, size_bytes, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time FROM ai_skill_package_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version_id = #{versionId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY file_path LIMIT 4096

SELECT FROM ai_agent_skill_package b JOIN ai_skill_package_version v ON v.id = b.version_id AND v.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND v.del_flag = 0 JOIN ai_skill_package p ON p.id = v.package_id AND p.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND p.del_flag = 0 WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.agent_id = #{agentId} AND b.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY b.create_time ASC, b.id ASC LIMIT 64
